# The 17:42 (十七時四十二分)

One evening train reaches Aonuma at 17:42. The last village bus leaves at 17:40. Three short episodes about the people on either side of those two minutes.

## Cast

- **Riko**: 17. Carrying her grandmother’s repaired radio home to Aonuma.
- **Mr. Sato**: 44. Office commuter. Has taken this train for nine years.
- **Mr. Ishida**: 70s. Reads the paper on the Momiji bench every evening.
- **Fusae**: Riko’s grandmother, heard on the phone. Dry, unbothered.
- **Mrs. Hara**: 53. Runs the kiosk at Aonuma. Closes at six.
- **Mr. Tanabe**: 47. Missed the same bus. Has written to the railway.
